fee_details:

- 2nd year onwards: Rs.4999 + Taxes (Waived on annual spend of Rs.2 Lakh)

key_highlights:
-Avail a Gift Voucher of Rs.5000 on payment of the annual fees.
-Get free movie tickets worth Rs.6,000 every year.
-Earn up to 50,000 bonus reward points worth Rs.12,500 per annum.

benefits_features.Welcome benefits: A Gift Voucher of Rs.5,000 on payment of the annual fees. You can choose vouchers from any of the following brands: Yatra, Hush Puppies, Bata, Adidas, Ajio, Biba, Fashion and Shoppers Stop
benefits_features.Entertainment benefits: Two offers will be valid for a minimum 2 tickets per booking per month. A maximum discount of Rs.250 per ticket will be available for two tickets.
benefits_features.Miscellaneous benefits: Earn up to 50,000 bonus reward points worth Rs.12,500 per annum. Earn up to 80,000 bonus points on an annual expenditure of Rs.2 Lakh and Rs.4 Lakh. Earn up to 15,000 bonus points on annual spends of Rs.5 Lakh and Rs.8 Lakh. When you spend Rs.10 Lakh in a year, the annual fee for the previous year will be reversed.
benefits_features.ELITE Rewards: Earn 2X reward points for spending at department stores, dining, and groceries. Earn 2 reward points for every Rs.100 spent on all other spends. Round bonus points earned on all spends.
benefits_features.Tridents membership benefits: Get 1,000 welcome points when you become a member. You get 1,500 bonus points on your first stay. You get an additional 50,000 points (one-night free stay).
benefits_features.Airport and lounge benefits: Get access to the Priority Pass Programme worth Rs.99. Get 2 complimentary International Airport lounge visits every year (2 visits per quarter). You get 2 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits every quarter.
benefits_features.Low Foreign Exchange Markup: The SBI ELITE card offers the lowest foreign currency mark-up at 1.99% for international use.
benefits_features.Vistara Membership benefits: You get a free Vistara Silver membership. 1 free upgrade voucher. Earn 5X Club Vistara points for every Rs. 100 spent on Vistara Flights.
benefits_features.Concierge Service: With this card, you are entitled to receive assistance from the team with travel bookings, holiday packages, movies and dining reservations.

how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points Earned on SB:
You can redeem your reward points via the SBI credit card banking website.
Step 1: Log in to your net banking account.
Step 2: Select the option of "Redeem rewards" from the main page.
Step 3: Your rewards will be shown on the left-hand side of the page.
Step 4: Choose the reward category from which you wish to redeem the points.
Step 5: Add to your cart.
Step 6: Input the quantity of the reward and then select "Add to cart".
Step 7: Check the disclaimer and then select the option of "Place order".

miscellaneous: The credit limit of the SBI ELITE card is given at the discretion of the bank. There are several factors involved which affect whether the applicant is eligible for credit and the limit. faqs.How much is the membership fee for SBI E: The annual membership fee for the SBI ELITE credit card is Rs. 4999. The annual fee will be waived if you spend Rs.2,00,000 or more in a year for a year.
faqs.Explain the fraud liability coverage wit: Cardholders are offered fraud liability coverage with this card. You will need to report it to the bank within 48 hours. You will need to visit the website of the bank or call the SBI customer care helpline before.
faqs.What is the cash advance limit for this: The cash advance limit for this card is up to 50% of your total credit limit.
faqs.Can I apply for supplementary cards?: Yes, you can avail of various add-on cards on the SBI ELITE card. You can apply for a supplementary card by visiting any of the nearest branches.
faqs.Does this card have any green benefits?: Yes, you can enjoy four months of free access and up to 50% discounts on golf passes. This comes with 1 free lesson every month at golf courses in the country.
faqs.Will the credit limit of this card autom: Many credit card limits and credit accounts renew in a period, and this card will automatically increase the credit limit. However, you can always request for your credit limit to be reviewed and increase.
faqs.How do I increase my credit limit on an: An increase in the credit limit can actually improve your credit score. This will give you more access to funds in case you have an emergency.
faqs.What if I lose my SBI ELITE card?: The facility to replace your SBI ELITE card is available all over the world.
faqs.Does the SBI ELITE card offer fuel surch: Yes, a fuel surcharge is waived off for all transactions between Rs.500 and Rs.4,000 at petrol pumps in the country.
faqs.What is the foreign currency mark-up cha: The foreign currency mark-up charged on the SBI ELITE card is 1.99%.
